verdict.rationale: Notte's docs say it can "persist cookies and login state across sessions", and its site advertises "Authenticated Profiles" as browser profiles for each agent. Together these cover the core of the story: saved logged-in state reused across runs so agents skip login. Both are one-line claims with no deeper detail. Missing for 10: in-depth profile documentation (how profiles are created, attached, reused and expire), any code example of reuse across runs, and independent or hands-on proof that agents actually skip the login wall.
